name: Windows Compliance Baseline (sample)
description: A minimal, adoptable Windows 10/11 device compliance policy. Ships with cmProjectX so /packs is non-empty out of the box: adopt it against your tenant (bind targetGroupId) to render an M15 plan and, on approval, create the policy with a snapshot + audit entry.

parameters.name: targetGroupId
parameters.prompt: Entra group to assign the baseline to

parameters.name: gracePeriodDays
parameters.prompt: Non-compliance grace period (days) before the action fires
